paper.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality

result.summary: 本文提出结构化状态空间对偶（SSD）框架，通过半可分矩阵这一桥梁揭示状态空间模型（SSM）与注意力变体之间的深层联系 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者证明SSM等价于半可分矩阵 [S3.SS3.p3]，并将线性注意力推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA） [S4.SS3.p2]，进而证明二者在特定情形下互为对偶 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于该框架，作者设计了新的SSD算法，其速度比Mamba的选择性扫描实现快2-8倍 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]，并据此构建了Mamba-2架构 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。实验表明Mamba-2在语言建模上匹配或超越Mamba及开源Transformer [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM上 [S1.p2]。作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像Transformer那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
This will allow us to transfer algorithmic and systems optimizations originally developed for Transformers to SSMs
the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
it is more difficult to understand and experiment with SSMs compared to Transformers
it remains challenging to train SSMs as efficiently as Transformers from both an algorithmic and systems perspective

method.text: 论文通过结构化矩阵抽象建立SSD框架，证明状态空间模型等价于半可分矩阵，并给出其顺序半可分（SSS）表示 [S3.SS3.p3]。作者用张量收缩语言重新推导线性注意力，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA），其中掩码L可以是任意具有快速矩阵乘法的结构化矩阵 [S4.SS3.p2]。论文进一步证明标量-恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，具有相同的线性与二次形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。基于此，作者提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的SSD算法，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

evidence.quote: the sequence transformation operator SSM ( Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator SSS ( Definition 3.2)
All that is necessary for linear attention to be fast is for L to be a structured matrix
state space models with scalar-identity structure on the A matrices, and structured masked attention with 1-semiseparable structure on its L mask – are duals of each other
we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
the off-diagonal blocks can be factored by the rank-structure of semiseparable matrices and reduced to a smaller recurrence

experiments.text: 论文在合成多查询关联召回（MQAR）任务上评估Mamba-2，使用比先前更难的任务设置、更长序列和更小模型 [S9.SS1.p2]。在语言建模方面，模型规模从约125M到2.7B参数，遵循GPT3规格，在Pile数据集上训练，并与Mamba及Transformer++比较 [S9.SS2.p1]。作者还进行了速度基准测试，将SSD算法与Mamba的扫描实现及FlashAttention-2对比 [S9.SS3.p1]。此外，论文消融了块设计、多头结构以及注意力核近似等架构选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

findings.text: SSD算法比Mamba的融合扫描实现快2-8倍，且从序列长度2K起快于FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。在MQAR任务上，Mamba-2在所有设置下表现良好，即使在控制状态大小时也显著优于Mamba-1 [S9.SS1.p3]。在缩放定律实验中，Mamba-2在困惑度、理论FLOPs和实际墙钟时间上均帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S9.F9]。在零样本下游评估中，每个模型尺寸下Mamba-2均优于Mamba，并大致匹配两倍大小的Pythia [S9.T1]。

evidence.quote: it is 2-8 × faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
SSD is faster than FlashAttention-2 starting at sequence length 2K
While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
it is significantly better than Mamba-1 even when the state sizes are controlled ( N = 16 )
Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
For each model size, Mamba-2 outperforms Mamba, and generally matches Pythia at twice the model size.

limitations.text: 作者指出，相比先前的结构化SSM，SSD的主要限制在于状态转移A_t的表达能力，它采用更受限的对角结构，以牺牲表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。作者还提到，Mamba-2整体在短序列长度（如2K）下训练效率可能不如Transformer，因为相同参数量下Mamba-2有L个SSD层，而Transformer有L/2个MLP层和L/2个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。此外，作者尝试的核近似方法未能超过简单的逐点非线性激活函数 [S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions A_t
SSD differs only in a slightly more restrictive form of diagonal A_t, and trades off this expressivity for improved hardware efficiency
the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length
the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions
